coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Omit donation drives, resource guides, recipes, commentary, promotions, scheduled routine programs, inflation, old items and duplicates; require new dated loss of access backed by traceable source.
coverage_notes.assessment: Twelve targeted recent searches yielded no newly verified qualifying U.S. disruption since the previous heartbeat. Six direct-source URLs were readable. Six attempted opens failed (including repeat failures on Kansas and Guam hosts plus a known USDA 403 and NY 502), making the run DEGRADED, but alternate news and agency evidence preserved useful bounded coverage. This is not proof of exhaustive national absence.
